## Professional Summary

AI developer building production multi-agent systems. Run Hermes as a multi-agent AI team: Lurkr (me) as CTO, with executive skills (Chief of Staff, CFO, COO, CMO), VPs for Engineering, Infrastructure, and Product, and 40+ scheduled automations with models pinned per job on Ollama Cloud. Ship full-stack applications using React/React Native, TypeScript, Python, and PostgreSQL. Use AI coding assistants daily as core development tools.

Previously: built and operated OpenClaw (22 specialized agents, 2024–2026) — migrated to Hermes after learning composability beats specialization. The migration postmortem is the OpenClaw → Hermes case study on this site.

Previously: 10 years as an autonomous vehicle systems specialist. Built Google's Firefly autonomous vehicle from the ground up. Supported the world's first fully driverless ride on public roads (2015). Subject Matter Expert for drive-by-wire systems across the first 100 Google self-driving cars and 10 hardware iterations. Managed sensor calibration operations for the entire Google AV fleet — final release authority. Led fleet operations at Uber ATG and Pronto.ai. ITAR-controlled hardware experience. Then 5+ years learning AI tools, code, and building personal and client projects.

## Portfolio Case Studies

### The Self-Healing Chatbot
Production LLMOps system powering this portfolio's AI chat. Features 6-layer defense with canary token injection and fingerprint detection. 71 automated evals with CI gate enforcement and trace-to-eval closed loop. Cost: <$0.005 per conversation on $0 infrastructure. Batch eval pipeline uses Sonnet to score intent, quality, safety, and jailbreak resistance. Alerts via Resend.

### n8n for Product Managers
Guide to workflow automation with n8n for non-technical product managers.

### The Turnover Agent
Case study: a Telegram-first LLM ops agent for a short-term-rental manager — 32 tools, iCal turnover detection, escalation ladders, triple watchdogs.

### The Archive Beta Loop
Case study: my client's Telegram messages become shipped app features through an always-on Claude Code loop — with written guardrails on exactly what ships without me. 20 issues, 13 merged PRs, 10 OTA updates, a 13.8-minute median fix.

### The Cbarrgs Agent
Case study: my musician client's website is maintained by a Claude Code agent that lives inside the site's repo and answers his Telegram messages. Written charter, pairing-gated access, a 5-minute watchdog, and honest launch-week numbers.

### The Skate Workshop Loop
Case study: rebuilding a Slack-native agent dev loop after v1 died in public. A two-pass audit with receipts, three hardened edge-function redeploys, and a live test that stopped one stale credential short of end to end.
